title: Using the Tsetlin Machine to Learn Human-Interpretable Rules for High-Accuracy Text Categorization with Medical Applications
abstract: arXiv:1809.04547v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical applications challenge today's text categorization techniques by demanding both high accuracy and ease-of-interpretation. Although deep learning has provided a leap ahead in accuracy, this leap comes at the sacrifice of interpretability. To address this accuracy-interpretability challenge, we here introduce, for the first time, a text categorization approach that leverages the recently introduced Tsetlin Machine. In all brevity, we represent the terms of a text as propositional variables. From these, we capture categories using simple propositional formulae, such as: if "rash" and "reaction" and "penicillin" then Allergy. The Tsetlin Machine learns these formulae from a labelled text, utilizing conjunctive clauses to represent the particular facets of each category. translated_title: 利用Tsetlin机器学习人类可解释规则以实现高精度文本分类及其医疗应用
translated_abstract: 医疗应用对当今的文本分类技术提出了双重挑战，要求同时具备高精度和易于解释性。尽管深度学习在精度上实现了飞跃，但这一飞跃是以牺牲可解释性为代价的。为应对这一精度与可解释性之间的挑战，我们首次提出了一种基于新近提出的Tsetlin机器的文本分类方法。简而言之，我们将文本中的词项表示为命题变量，并基于这些变量使用简单的命题公式来捕捉类别，例如：如果文本中出现“皮疹”、“反应”和“青霉素”这些词，则分类为过敏（Allergy）。Tsetlin机器从带标注的文本中学习这些公式，利用合取子句来表示每个类别的特定特征。实际上，甚至词项的缺失（即否定特征）也可以用于分类目的。我们与朴素贝叶斯、决策树、线性支持向量机等方法的实证比较（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文首次提出基于Tsetlin机器的文本分类方法，通过学习人类可解释的简单命题规则（如合取子句），在医疗文本分类任务中同时实现高精度与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces, for the first time, a text categorization approach based on the Tsetlin Machine that learns human-interpretable propositional rules, achieving both high accuracy and interpretability for medical text classification.
